origin.note: The source states that matched removed and added a/T/Y and b/T/Y patterns have the same size and therefore contribute the same number of completions.

nl.text:
For every `B : PerturbedStarBlocks n r`, every natural number `d`, and every finite set `Y` with `Y ⊆ B.L`, the exact completion weights of the matched deleted and added patterns are equal:

`Nat.choose (perturbedStarFiller B).card (d + 1 - ({B.a} ∪ B.T ∪ Y).card) = Nat.choose (perturbedStarFiller B).card (d + 1 - ({B.b} ∪ B.T ∪ Y).card)`.

No additional hypotheses, including `hrd` or `hrn`, are assumed.
